title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces
author: Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau, Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau
description: A widely used operating systems textbook organized around three themes: virtualization (CPU and memory), concurrency (locks and condition variables), and persistence (disks, RAID, and file systems).
